description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 12 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content contains the publication of a provincial statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 12 of 2017) that amends previous appropriation statutes and modifies financial regulations and account limits for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and amendments to existing legislation, falling under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
